query: I was walking my golden retriever this morning and he ran off to chase a squirrel, knocked over a neighbor's potted peony, and I spent almost half an hour apologizing and helping them clean up the mess. Then when I got home I tried to make iced coffee and accidentally spilled half the carton of oat milk all over my kitchen counter, had to wipe everything down and mop the floor too. Oh right, I also just got a notification that my favorite bakery around the corner is releasing a new matcha scone flavor this weekend, I've been waiting for that for months. Anyway, I need to return some items from my delivered order #W5272531, the items I want to return are 7228247242, 2698416822, 8098621301 and 3320557165, and please process the refund to credit_card_6824399.
